**Prior Degrees:** Baccalauréat specialised in science in 2018

I am Ugo DOUILLARD a french student doing an internship at the CCWJ for 4 months. It is my first time in Canada. I have arrived at the end of April 2022. In France I am doing an Meng specialised in the study of structural materials. I have already done a research projet on superconducting materials with J. Noudem at the CRISMAT in Caen. At the CCWJ I will be working on the FSW machine to learn more about friction stir welding. I like playing soccer and video games, and hang out with my friends. 

#### Project

I am doing an internship at the ccwj to fullfil my Meng in France. I will be working on the FSW machine on aluminium aloys or on steel.
